introHtml: BIC dispensary containers combine the reliability of America's most trusted pen brand with the convenience of single-use dispensing. Ideal for medical offices, dental clinics, and pharmacies, these containers eliminate cross-contamination while ensuring patients always have a writing instrument. Choose from classic ballpoints like the BIC Round Stic or gel options like the Intensity Clic, all customizable with your logo or practice name via pad printing or laser engraving. Stock your waiting rooms and exam rooms with branded BIC pens that patients will appreciate.
